text:
Anita: Quick pulse — our webinar leads dashboard shows a ~18% drop in MQL conversion last week. Anyone else seeing an attribution mismatch between GA and the CDP? https://redwood.in/metrics/webinar-leads :eyes:
Jordan: Yup. I noticed GA session attribution vs CDP event-level dedupe is diverging after the form change. numbers look ~15–20% off depending on filter.
Sam: Can you paste the exact filter/query you used? want to compare to the weekly KPI view i pull for the board.
Jordan: Pasting quick query (postgres):
```
SELECT utm_source, count(distinct lead_id) as leads
FROM events
WHERE event_type='webinar_register'
  AND occurred_at >= '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY utm_source
ORDER BY leads desc;
```
Jordan: That gives the raw event count. CDP applies a 24h dedupe + case-insensitive email fingerprinting after ingestion. GA is attributing to last non-direct session.
Lee: FYI we updated the registration form last Thursday to map utm_campaign -> campaign_id (renamed param). think some old UTM rules stopped matching.
Anita: ugh — that would explain part of it. Lee, can you confirm which Sunday deploy changed the param mapping?
Lee: It was a small product deploy on 2026-02-26. I pushed a change to the form JS — variable name changed. I flagged it in the release notes but not in marketing ops.
Maya: We need a reconciled number for tomorrow's weekly KPI review. Is it realistic to have a reconciled MQL count by EOD?
Sam: I can pull the GA session-based exports and raw CDP events and do a row-level join to see overlap. give me till 4pm.
Jordan: I’ll run a dedupe-on-raw pipeline that mirrors CDP logic locally and produce a delta report (GA vs CDP vs raw events). putting a note: potential root causes = utm param rename, cookie/session timeouts, email normalization differences.
Anita: Plan: Lee confirms deploy + original param name; Sam pulls GA exports and shares sample CSV; Jordan runs reconciliation; I’ll patch the KPI dashboard to show both "CDP MQL" and "Reconciled MQL" columns and add a short note.
dashbot: Daily snapshot job scheduled: webinar_leads_delta will run at 16:30 UTC and post summary to #marketing.
Maya: thanks — prioritize reconciled number. If we can’t reconcile fully, show both numbers and add a one-line explanation in the deck.
Lee: Confirmed — original param was `utm_campaign` and my change renamed to `campaign_id`. I opened PR to map both for 7 days. PR: https://github.com/redwood/app/pull/4821
Sam: Uploading GA export to /tmp/ga_webinar_export_2026-02-26.csv and sharing sample in the drive.
Jordan: Running join now; preliminary delta = -17% CDP vs reconciled raw (consistent with Anita's observation). will drop table and attach CSV by 15:30.
Anita: Great. I'll update the dashboard to include a reconciliation note and add the reconciled metric. Will also add an annotation on 2026-02-26 about the param rename.
Maya: Perfect. Can we also add a short blurb in the KPI deck: "Minor tracking rename on 2/26 caused undercount in CDP; reconciled number used for this week's MQLs."
